deduplicate_crystal_structures: deduplicate a pandas DataFrame of crystal structures using hash-based pre-filtering and parallel crystallographic comparison
deduplicate_and_remove_duplicates: deduplicate crystal structures in a DataFrame and remove duplicate entries keeping one representative per group
process_structure_group_clustering: process a pre-filtered group of crystal structures and assign subgroup IDs using greedy clustering with StructureMatcher
configure_deduplication_tolerance: configure lattice tolerance, site tolerance, and angle tolerance parameters for crystal structure deduplication
parallel_deduplication_with_n_jobs: run parallel crystal structure deduplication across multiple CPU cores using configurable n_jobs parameter
